description: This file contains cryptographic big number arithmetic functions, including multiplication, squaring, division, addition, and multiplication with specific hardware optimizations. It provides implementations for multiple architectures and preprocessor configurations, mainly used in OpenSSL or similar SSL/TLS cryptography libraries.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_mul_add_words(BN_ULONG * rp,BN_ULONG * ap,int num,BN_ULONG w)
methods.description: Performs multiplication and addition over an array of words, optimized for different architectures, with assertions on input validity.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_mul_words(BN_ULONG * rp,BN_ULONG * ap,int num,BN_ULONG w)
methods.description: Multiplies an array of words by a single word, producing a product array, optimized for different architectures.

methods.name: void bn_sqr_words(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,int n)
methods.description: Squares an array of words, optimized for various architectures.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_div_words(BN_ULONG h,BN_ULONG l,BN_ULONG d)
methods.description: Divides a combined high and low word by a divisor, returning the quotient.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_add_words(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,BN_ULONG * b,int n)
methods.description: Adds two arrays of words with carry, returning the final carry, with implementations for architectures with and without 64-bit support.
